---
title: "Exercises"
---

::: {.callout-important title="Clone the exercises repository"}
These exercises use the companion repository **[intro-to-renv-exercises](https://github.com/lmu-osc/introduction-to-renv-exercises){target="_blank"}**. Clone it before you start, either in RStudio with *File > New Project > Version Control > Git* or at the command line:

```bash
# change to the directory where you want the repo first, e.g. `cd ~/Documents`
git clone https://github.com/lmu-osc/introduction-to-renv-exercises.git
```
:::

Put what you've learned into practice with hands-on walkthroughs. Each exercise provides step-by-step instructions and highlights common pitfalls.

- **[Init and Snapshot](example-init-snapshot.qmd)** — Initialize {renv} in a project and take a snapshot of its dependencies.
- **[Restore](example-restore.qmd)** — Recreate a project environment from an existing lockfile.
- **[Explicitly Record](example-explicit-record.qmd)** — Manually record packages in the lockfile using `dependencies()` and `record()`.
